Hi Kimberly,

Great to meet you briefly at the partner kickoff last week — thanks for the intro via Marissa. CloudWave is ready to run a joint marketplace demo for our mutual customer cohort. The goal: a 60-minute co-sell session showing the CloudWave integration running on Azure marketplace with Redwood Inference as the inference runtime, and a quick AWS SI perspective on integration patterns.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue 23 Jun, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 24 Jun, 14:00–15:00
- Thu 25 Jun, 08:30–09:30

High-level agenda: 1) 10 min intros, 2) 30 min demo (CloudWave + Redwood), 3) 15 min SI notes, 4) 5 min next steps.

Can you confirm availability or share a different time? Also curious whether we should do a 20–30m technical pre-call (redwood infra + CloudWave infra) the day before.

Attachments: initial_agenda_v1.pdf (light outline)

Thanks,
Sarah Mitchell
